playlistSemanticNotes.reason: URL variables are optional when segment URLs need no templating.
A valid encoder boundary may be present when Ether restarts a stream.
A valid declaration that segments can be decoded independently is optional.
Servers may segment the same duration differently; each playlist is validated and completed total duration is compared within tolerance.
